issue_context.title: Update internal unconditional rollover calls to use lazy rollover
issue_context.body:
### Description

Currently we have some of our `IndexTemplateRegistry` subclasses that invoke unconditional rollovers after templates have been upgraded. One thing that would be good to do is to make use of the recently merged [lazy rollover flag](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/103309) for these calls.

We can look at uses of the `applyRolloverAfterTemplateV2Upgrade()` flag to see where these are used.
